def process(loadBoston, loadChatham, loadAmherst, loadAshburnham):
    import pandas as pd

    def _prep(df: pd.DataFrame, region: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        out = df.copy()
        # Keep only actual yearly rows; drop summary rows like Max/Min that appear in the Year column.
        out['Year_num'] = pd.to_numeric(out['Year'], errors='coerce')
        out = out[out['Year_num'].notna()].copy()
        out = out[out['Year_num'].astype(int) == 2020].copy()

        # Convert month columns to numeric; treat 'M' and other non-numeric as NaN.
        for m in ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']:
            out[m] = pd.to_numeric(out[m], errors='coerce')

        out['summerRain'] = out[['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']].sum(axis=1, skipna=True)
        out['region'] = region
        return out[['region', 'Year_num', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'summerRain']]

    combined = pd.concat([
        _prep(loadBoston, 'Boston'),
        _prep(loadChatham, 'Chatham'),
        _prep(loadAmherst, 'Amherst'),
        _prep(loadAshburnham, 'Ashburnham'),
    ], ignore_index=True)

    # In case any region has all 3 months missing (sum would be 0); set to NaN so it won't incorrectly win.
    all_missing = combined[['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']].isna().all(axis=1)
    combined.loc[all_missing, 'summerRain'] = pd.NA

    return combined.sort_values('summerRain', ascending=False, na_position='last').reset_index(drop=True)
